meta.name: Process and log Gmail invoices with GPT-4.1-mini, Google Sheets, and Drive

parameters.content:
## N8N-Invoice Processor - G

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to process unread Gmail invoice messages. It reads configuration and existing sheet data, extracts text from email/PDF content, uses OpenAI to identify invoice fields, classifies the result, saves PDF attachments to Google Drive, updates Google Sheets, marks processed emails in Gmail, and sends a daily digest.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the desired processing time and timezone.
- Set the configuration node values, especially digestTo, spreadsheetId, invoicesSheet, and receiptsSheet.
- Connect Gmail credentials with permissions to read messages, modify labels/read status, and send the digest email.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials for the target spreadsheet and verify the invoice and receipt sheet column structure matches the formatting code.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and confirm the upload path/folder logic used for PDF attachments.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the GPT-4.1-mini chat model and verify the extraction prompt/output JSON matches the parsing code.

### Customization

Adjust the Gmail search criteria, processed label name, invoice classification rules, spreadsheet row format, digest email template, attachment upload path, and the daily schedule to match your accounting process.

## Daily configuration start

Starts the workflow on the daily schedule and sets shared runtime parameters such as recipient email, spreadsheet ID, and sheet names.

## Fetch source records

Reads existing invoice records from Google Sheets and fetches unread Gmail messages that may contain invoices or receipts.

## Prepare PDF text

Prepares each Gmail item for extraction, extracts text from PDF attachments, and restores email metadata after file text extraction.

## AI field extraction

Uses the OpenAI chat model through an LLM chain to extract structured invoice fields from the prepared message and PDF text.

## Parse and classify invoice

Parses the AI JSON output, matches it against invoice data, determines the needed sheet action, and formats the row payload for storage.

## Attachment branch decision

Checks whether the processed email has a PDF attachment and routes the item into either the upload path or the no-attachment passthrough path.

## Upload PDF attachments

Builds Drive upload paths, uploads PDF attachments to Google Drive, and captures the resulting PDF links grouped back by email.

## Merge attachment outcomes

Passes through emails without attachments using an empty PDF link and merges those items with the uploaded-attachment results.

## Mark Gmail processed

Marks the original Gmail messages as read and adds the processed label after attachment handling is complete.

## Send invoice digest

Filters successfully extracted invoice data, builds the daily summary email, and sends the digest through Gmail.

## Update accounting sheets

Routes each processed item to the correct Google Sheets action: append a new invoice, mark an invoice as paid, or append a receipt.

parameters.text:
=You are an expert financial-document classifier and data extractor for accounts payable. First classify the email, then extract fields based on that classification. Return ONLY a valid JSON object with no markdown, no code fences, no backticks, no explanation. Start your response with { and end with }.

The text may be plain text, structured email text, or HTML email converted to text. Forwarded emails may contain the invoice or receipt within the forwarded content. YOUR_COMPANY_NAME is not a vendor; that is your own company (replace YOUR_COMPANY_NAME with your business name so the AI never logs your own outbound invoices as payables). If you are unsure of a vendor, inspect the from address and resolve the domain to an entity.

STEP 1 — CLASSIFY: set "documentType" to one of:
- "invoice": a bill requesting payment, a statement of charges, or a subscription/recurring charge notice (even if it states the charge was already processed automatically)
- "receipt": a payment confirmation, "thank you for your payment", a charge confirmation from a payment processor, or proof of payment that is not itself the original bill
- "other": anything else (marketing, newsletters, unrelated correspondence)

STEP 2 — IF documentType is "invoice", also extract:
- invoiceNumber: unique alphanumeric identifier (string or null)
- poNumber: purchase order number (string or null)
- vendorName: legal name of the vendor (string or null)
- contactInfo: billing contact email or phone (string or null)
- issueDate: invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format (string or null)
- dueDate: payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (string or null)
- subtotal: total before tax as number (number or null)
- taxAmount: total tax amount as number (number or null)
- totalAmountDue: final total as number (number or null)
- currency: three-letter currency code e.g. USD, EUR (string or null)
- paymentTerms: e.g. Net 30, Due on Receipt (string or null)
- description: brief description of goods/services (string or null)
- quantityHours: quantity or hours, comma-separated if multiple (string or null)
- unitPrice: unit price or rate, comma-separated if multiple (string or null)
- paymentStatus: "Paid" ONLY if the invoice text itself explicitly states the balance was already paid or automatically charged (e.g. "payment received", "charged automatically", "paid in full", "your card was charged"). Otherwise "Unpaid". (string, required)
If documentType is not "invoice", set all of the above to null except paymentStatus which should be "Unpaid".

STEP 3 — IF documentType is "receipt", also extract:
- receiptVendorName: legal name of the vendor being paid (string or null)
- receiptInvoiceNumber: the original invoice or order number being paid, if referenced (string or null)
- receiptAmount: amount paid, as number (number or null)
- receiptDate: date payment was made in YYYY-MM-DD format (string or null)
- receiptPaymentMethod: e.g. "Visa ending 1234", "ACH", "PayPal", "autopay" (string or null)
- receiptReference: receipt or confirmation number if present (string or null)
If documentType is not "receipt", set all of the above to null.
